name: Eastward Ho! Country Club
centre_source: OpenGolfAPI's OpenStreetMap link (41.7172022, -69.9826558); where2golf 41.717270, -69.982764; Stymie 41.715873, -69.982199. Probably near the clubhouse at the middle of the figure-8; the box allows for that.
renovations: 2004 (13 Sept - 23 Dec): Keith Foster, 13 lost bunkers and 13 greens restored, all tees and the other 46 bunkers renovated, ~20 acres of native grasses; thousands of trees removed from 2000 on
2007: Keith Foster (and Kevin Hargrave); 2014: Kevin Hargrave (GolfPass credits)

2019-2024: Kyle Franz, full restoration finished 2024: greens enlarged (28,000+ sq ft), Fowler bunkers restored plus new ones (one in 8's fairway), sand scrapes in place of fescue and trees, new back tees on 15 (+30 yd) and 18 (par 4 or 5), 4 made Biarritz-like
notable: GOLF Top 100 Courses in the US #50 (2024-25)
